payload.auto_place_doc: auto_place_eligible=True means the pack may proceed on the FULL AUTO path (prepare → execute_pass final gate → order-QA PASS → Trader_Classic places via MCP). True only if: no hard flags, instrument guard OK (resolved US stock/ETF id), long-only x1 buy, book snapshot not stale, soft mandate gates allow new buys (a --force run is never eligible), and the preliminary cost gate verdict is PASS (not COST_GATE_SKIP / COST_GATE_INVALID). It is NOT a place instruction; do_not_place=True still means this script never places. run-QA PASS is still required first.
